supersession_reason: Source preflight found no ask candles for VOL.IDX/USD; v2 registers that context proxy as bid-only before any historical outcome join or evaluation.
purpose: Exploratory point-in-time cross-asset information for XAUUSD paper research; no signal or deployment authorization

provider.name: dukascopy-public
provider.access: account-free public historical candle endpoint via dukascopy-python
provider.availability_semantics: a 1H candle becomes observable only at open_time + 1 hour

dollar_idx.price_input: midpoint derived from matched bid and ask OHLC

silver.price_input: midpoint derived from matched bid and ask OHLC

volatility_idx.price_input: bid OHLC only; source preflight returned no ask candles

treasury_bond.role: Dukascopy US Treasury-bond total-return CFD; duration/rates-direction proxy
treasury_bond.price_input: midpoint derived from matched bid and ask OHLC

join_contract.candidate_timestamp_semantics: information available at XAUUSD candidate decision close
join_contract.method: backward as-of join on context available_at_utc <= candidate timestamp
join_contract.missing_policy: preserve missing values, add per-instrument missing and staleness features, and fit any imputation on training folds only
join_contract.holiday_policy: carry the most recently observable value only inside the maximum-staleness limit

economic_rationale: Dollar strength may condition gold direction and follow-through.
Silver and the gold/silver ratio may identify precious-metals confirmation or divergence.
Volatility and Treasury-bond proxies may identify risk and rates-direction regimes.
research_hypothesis.null: Point-in-time context features do not improve chronological candidate ranking over the matching no-context baselines.

evaluation_contract.purge: actual target exit must precede calibration or test boundary
evaluation_contract.selection_threshold: 80th percentile of model scores in the prior calibration slice
evaluation_contract.fit_weighting: average inverse target-interval concurrency normalized to mean one
evaluation_contract.direction_reporting: BUY and SELL separate plus combined
primary_development_gates: primary-target rank-IC lower 95% bound greater than zero
primary-target selected-return lower 95% bound greater than zero
primary-target selected-excess lower 95% bound greater than zero
positive primary-target selected return in at least three folds
paired weekly-bootstrap improvement over the matched no-context model lower 95% bound greater than zero

change_rule: Any instrument, feature, timing, staleness, target, model-ladder or gate change requires a new contract version before inspecting the affected result.
